Consulting estimates and site terms

What a project estimate covers and what you buy directly.

Estimates and agreements

Prices and calculator totals are planning estimates in USD. Your statement of work specifies the one-time implementation fee, deliverables, and acceptance checks. You purchase hardware and provider services in your own name.

Software and operating costs

The agreed open-source stack carries no per-seat license fee. Upstream software remains subject to its license. Budget for infrastructure, storage, and your team’s time to operate the system.

Comparison data

Vendor pricing and feature availability can change. Check the quoted edition, current terms, and required integrations before approving the scope.
